# Modelry

Modelry is a 3D visualization platform for eCommerce that creates custom 3D product models, AR experiences, and digital asset management.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/modelry/.

## Actions

- **Create Workspace**: Create a new workspace.
- **Delete Modelry Embed**: Delete an embed.
- **Delete Modelry Product**: Delete a product.
- **Delete Modelry Workspace**: Delete a workspace.
- **Delete Product Repository**: Delete a product repository.
- **Get Embed** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific embed.
- **Get Product Repository** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific product repository.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific workspace.
- **List Embeds** (read-only): List available embeds.
- **List Modeling Requests** (read-only): List all 3d modeling requests associated with the authenticated user's workspace.
- **List Modelry Products** (read-only): List all products in modelry.
- **List Modelry Workspaces** (read-only): List all workspaces in modelry.
- **List Product Repositories** (read-only): List all product repositories in a workspace.
- **Order Modeling Service**: Place an order for 3d modeling services.
- **Track Modeling Progress** (read-only): Track the progress of a 3d modeling request.
